settings.description: How each kind of order reaches you.

settings.label: Physical
settings.heading: Prints and paper goods
settings.text: Prints and paper goods leave the studio within three working days, packed flat or rolled in a tube, with tracking. Most parcels arrive within a week.

settings.label: Digital
settings.heading: Brushes and files
settings.text: Brushes, wallpapers and other files arrive as a download link by email the moment you pay. The link stays in your account, so you can download again on a new device.

settings.label: Course
settings.heading: Lessons
settings.text: The course is yours once you pay: every lesson, as often as you like, including lessons added later.

settings.label: Abroad
settings.heading: Shipping outside the country
settings.text: Yes, to most countries. The delivery price for yours is shown at checkout before you pay. Downloads and the course work anywhere.

settings.label: Returns
settings.heading: Changed your mind
settings.text: Send a print or paper item back unused within 30 days for a full refund. Downloads and the course can be refunded within 14 days if you have not opened them.

settings.label: Help
settings.heading: Something went wrong
settings.text: Write with your order number and a photo if it helps. I will put it right.
